answer: Each identity proves it holds its own sealed replica of a shared archive, encoded by a sequential seal keyed to its address, and random sector challenges each epoch must be answered within two seconds. A replica sealed for one key is hollow for any other, and resealing on demand takes hours, so clones cannot bridge one disk across names. Replica size doubles for each extra identity funded from the same wallet: a ring of ten needs 1,023 units of disk while one honest agent stores one. Keys that pass earn a jade badge that unlocks grading seats.
